audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted the packet chart and the page's own whys. The chart called Level 1 even while whys[0] says Kled owns that window outright; it gave Level 2 to Kled while whys[1] calls it even; it gave Levels 3, 4-5, 6 and First item to Kled or Skill while whys[2] through whys[5] describe an Irelia takeover in every one of them.
audit.why: A 53.31% win rate over 287 Emerald+ games is an Irelia mid-lane, not a Kled-favoured chart. Both layers were wrong in the same direction, so the two-layer check saw no disagreement.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped in both layers as one atomic group: Kled, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Kled. Ratings moved to match. Row 6 stays Kled.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues on this page — not one 'wait for X before you Y' line, and no cooldown number anywhere despite Kled running his whole kit on zero mana.
audit.why: Kled pays nothing to cast, so cooldowns are the only resource read available. Bear Trap on a Rope is 9s at rank 3 and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 110s at rank 3 — those two numbers are the entire timing of the lane.
audit.corrected: Bear Trap's 9s rank-3 cooldown written into whys[3], Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s 110s into spikes[3], and the bait-the-ult-then-burst order into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is described only as a re-engage; its shield is never mentioned, so the page never tells the player to force it out before committing burst. Violent Tendencies (W) — four massively fast attacks, effectively an auto reset on a 9-13s cooldown — is never named at all, so the reader has no tell for when his damage actually starts.
audit.why: Committing your all-in into a fresh shield is the standard way this lane is lost from ahead, and the W wind-up is the moment to step back rather than the moment he casts anything visible.
audit.corrected: R's shield and the bait-first order added to mid and spikes[3]; the Violent Tendencies wind-up added to wants.you[1] as the step-back tell.

audit.why: Defiant Dance (W) reduces physical damage and Kled's damage is physical throughout, so the existing 'W eats his committed Q' advice is genuinely right here and was left alone.

edits.before: Your maxed Bladesurge passive shreds his thin dismounted resists — you out-skirmish him around the Bear Trap cooldown.
edits.after: Your stacked passive shreds his thin dismounted resists — step in the moment Bear Trap whiffs, it's 9 seconds at rank 3.

edits.before: Kled out-scales — Skaarl's courage-driven remount refills his health bar mid-fight and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) re-engages duels you'd win, so close the lane before this.
edits.after: Kled out-scales — Skaarl's remount refills his health bar mid-fight, and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) brings a shield plus a re-engage every 110 seconds, so close the lane before this.

edits.before: Sidestep his Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) skillshot; when it whiffs, dash in on the cooldown window and chain Q-resets off the minions he's farming
edits.after: Step back on the Violent Tendencies (W) wind-up, not the cast — those four fast attacks are his damage; re-enter once the trap has whiffed

edits.before: This is your takeover. Your maxed Bladesurge passive shreds his already-thin dismounted resists, and a well-timed Defiant Dance (W) channel eats the burst when he commits a mounted Q. Bait the Bear Trap on a Rope skillshot, and when it whiffs E-stun in and chain Q-resets to strip Skaarl's courage and force the dismount — a dismounted Kled with no minion nearby to remount is a free kill. At 6 your Vanguard's Edge (R) walls off his retreat so he can't reach a creep to remount, making every all-in lethal. Blade of the Ruined King plus full reset uptime is your single strongest point: force fights and snowball now.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Your maxed Bladesurge passive shreds his already-thin dismounted resists, and Defiant Dance (W) genuinely works here — his damage is physical end to end, so charge it when he commits a mounted Q. Bait the Bear Trap, and when it whiffs E-stun in and chain Q-resets to strip Skaarl's courage and force the dismount. At 6 his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! carries a shield, so make him spend it before you burst; then Vanguard's Edge (R) walls off the path back to a minion he needs to remount. Blade of the Ruined King plus full reset uptime is your peak: force fights now.

notes: Six chart rows were inverted against both the packet and the page's own prose and are flipped here as one matched group with ratings. The packet also flagged zero sequencing cues on this page; Bear Trap's 9s rank-3 and Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s 110s are now on the page, and Kled's zero-cost kit means cooldowns are the only read. Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s shield and the Violent Tendencies wind-up were both entirely absent and are now stated. Nothing is asserted about whether Vanguard's Edge terrain can physically stop the ult charge — the kit text does not settle that.
